world_org_meetings.title: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
world_org_meetings.description: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

world_org_meetings.title: The G7 will release 100 million reserve barrels of diesel fuel over the next 4 months
world_org_meetings.description: After increased pressure from Washington, the G7 held an emergency meeting on energy. The world's wealthiest nations say they will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel fuel in their reserves.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 trade ministers are meeting in Wisconsin. Many will be discussing deals without their U.S. host
world_org_meetings.description: Most of the officials attending the G20 trade ministers' meeting in Milwaukee, Wisc., find themselves in challenging positions, largely because of U.S. President Donald Trump's global tariff agenda. It makes for a potentially unusual summit, with high-level meetings on the sidelines where different countries discuss plans to work around the host.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump’s tariffs loom over talks as G20 meets in US
world_org_meetings.description: Trade ministers of the Group of 20 are meeting in Milwaukee for two days of talks on Wednesday, but US President Donald Trump’s tariffs are expected to hang heavy over the talks. "Don't expect any breakthroughs," an analyst watching the event said.

world_org_meetings.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
world_org_meetings.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

diplomatic_visits.title: Rubio visits Portugal, praising a 'great ally' and looking to build deeper ties
diplomatic_visits.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in Portugal, wrapping up a tour of NATO allies

diplomatic_visits.title: Manny Pacquiao hosts Polish president Karol Nawrocki for Manila boxing workout
diplomatic_visits.description: Polish President Karol Nawrocki trains in Manila with boxing legend Manny Pacquiao, who now leads the Philippines’ National Anti-Poverty Commission.

diplomatic_visits.title: Gerhard Schröder visits latest Russian employer, Hyperglobus
diplomatic_visits.description: Former German Chancellor Gerhard Schröder visited a Moscow supermarket in his new role on the supervisory board. Schröder is no stranger to retirement stipends in Russia — or the scandal that accompanies them.

diplomatic_visits.title: EU trade envoy eyes yawning goods deficit on first day of China visit
diplomatic_visits.description: The EU's trade commissioner, Maros Sefcovic, arrived in Beijing this Thursday for two days of talks with his Chinese counterpart Wang Wentao. Sefcovic stated his goal of "rebalancing" an "unsustainable trade deficit". One particular area of concern is the auto sector, where Chinese hybrid vehicles have increased their European market share to 25 percent. Also in this edition: Microsoft unveils its new AI-powered PCs in a bid to rival Apple.

diplomatic_visits.title: UK, Germany to launch partnership to counter cyberattacks as Burnham visits Berlin
diplomatic_visits.description: Britain ⁠and Germany ​will launch a joint partnership to ​counter sabotage and cyberattacks as Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Chancellor Friedrich Merz meet ​in ‌Berlin on Thursday, shortly ⁠after both leaders warned of the hybrid threat ‌from Russia. France 24's Nick Holdsworth has the latest from Berlin.

elections.title: Polanski failed to show leadership over Zionism motion, ex-Green leader says
elections.description: Caroline Lucas tells the BBC Zack Polanski should have taken part in a vote on a motion declaring Zionism a form of racism.

elections.title: Spanish pensioner Maricarmen, symbol of country's housing crisis, dead at 87
elections.description: María del Carmen Abascal, a Spanish pensioner known widely as Maricarmen, died suddenly on Wednesday, two weeks after she was evicted from her apartment. Her death is set to reinvigorate the protest movement and further polarize Spain ahead of a national election next month, in which housing will be a central issue.

elections.title: South Sudan's road to elections remains uncertain
elections.description: South Sudan's first general election is set for December 22. Insecurity, political tensions and the failure to begin voter registration have raised doubts over whether a credible poll can be held.

elections.title: US midterms: Is Trump campaigning at taxpayers' expense?
elections.description: Despite not being on the ballot, Trump is campaigning hard ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. His tactics and promises have mostly been at the expense of US taypayers. Experts say some might violate federal law.

elections.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro wins third-place candidate’s support against Lula
elections.description: Brazil's right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro secured third-place finisher Augusto Cury's endorsement on Thursday, strengthening his position against incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva ahead of the runoff. Cury won nearly three percent in Sunday's first round. A Datafolha poll put Bolsonaro ahead with 52 percent against Lula's 48 percent.
